_note: PLACEHOLDER Camp Crystal Creek deck — swap this file to change the story without code changes.
host_rules: Guests 1–8 are the primary suspects (including the Chef, who is the secret killer).
Guests 9–20 are the camp investigators who hold eyewitness clues and red herrings.
If fewer than 20 people show up, hand out cards 1 through 8 first, then distribute investigator cards 9–20 in numerical order.

characters.title: The Stressed Camp Director
characters.secret_motive: Biff discovered you were embezzling camp funds to pay off personal gambling debts. He was going to expose you to the board tonight.
characters.alibi: You claim you were in the camp office counting tuck-shop cash at 8:00 PM.
characters.whisper_clue: I know for a fact the Camp Medic has been faking their medical credentials—I saw their real transcripts in the trash.

characters.title: The Star Athlete
characters.secret_motive: Biff sabotaged your canoe during last year's tournament, ruining your chances at a college scout scholarship.
characters.alibi: You claim you were doing push-ups near the archery range at 8:00 PM.
characters.whisper_clue: The Goth Camper was muttering about a 'blood sacrifice' by the lake right before Biff went missing.

characters.title: The Camp Medic
characters.secret_motive: Biff stole your private journal and was blackmailing you about a medical school exam you faked.
characters.alibi: You claim you were organizing bandages in the infirmary tent at 8:00 PM.
characters.whisper_clue: I found a financial ledger in the Director's cabin showing they owe half a million dollars to some very dangerous people.

characters.title: The Goth Camper
characters.secret_motive: Biff ruthlessly pranked you all summer. You publicly swore that "the camp monster would take him before Friday night."
characters.alibi: You claim you were wandering near the tree line alone listening to your Walkman at 8:00 PM.
characters.whisper_clue: Biff wasn't a hero. He dumped the Final Girl/Boy yesterday by taping a brutal note to the dining hall door.

characters.title: The Final Girl / Boy
characters.secret_motive: Biff dumped you yesterday via a public note taped to the dining hall door. You wanted revenge for the humiliation.
characters.alibi: You claim you were crying near the craft cabin at 8:00 PM.
characters.whisper_clue: The Rich Spoiled Kid's family owns the rival camp across the lake. They've been trying to shut us down all summer.

characters.title: The Rich Spoiled Kid
characters.secret_motive: Biff's family owns the rival camp across the lake. Your parents threatened to cut off your trust fund if you didn't help shut this camp down.
characters.alibi: You claim you were doing your multi-step skincare routine in the luxury cabins at 8:00 PM.
characters.whisper_clue: The Prankster was bragging earlier about a giant trap they set up to humiliate the staff tonight.

characters.title: The Prankster
characters.secret_motive: Biff caught you setting up a trap to dump green slime on the Director and threatened to get you expelled today.
characters.alibi: You claim you were hiding under a picnic table waiting to scare someone at 8:00 PM.
characters.whisper_clue: The Chef has a massive, old skull tattoo on their right forearm that they always try to hide with long sleeves.

characters.title: The Chef
characters.secret_motive: You are actually the legendary "Slasher of 1976" back for revenge. Biff recognized your tattoo from an old news clipping and was about to call the cops.
characters.alibi: You lie and say you were baking meat pies in the kitchen at 8:00 PM. (You may LIE if asked direct questions!)
characters.whisper_clue: I saw the Star Athlete throwing a bent canoe paddle into the bushes near the sports equipment bay. (Falsified Red Herring)

characters.title: The Camp Radio DJ
characters.whisper_clue: I intercepted a weird radio transmission. The local police department said the '1976 Camp Slasher' escaped from prison last week.
characters.goal: Mingle with everyone, trade your secret rumor, and figure out who killed Biff!
